Note: the underlying behavior is actually fine and well-tested (UIJ-SCENARIO-006 'corrupt coverage artifact does not satisfy the gate' exercises exactly this path and passed independently), so this is a classifier premise error, not an implementation defect -- re-adjudication should attach UIJ-SCENARIO-006 / node --test test/uiux-intake-judgment-gate.test.js as the covering evidence rather than leaving this item unevidenced.
